selection_policy: User-selected dog-in-flowers, teddy-bear and lighthouse subjects. Dog and lighthouse use the original preset prompts and noise; teddy bears reuse the saved validation outputs. Every method uses identical row prompts and noise. All 5000 validation images contribute to metrics, independently of this qualitative selection.
prompt_control_selection_policy: Choose one complete 3-by-4 grid by visual quality and animal/action adherence from four fixed candidate seeds; every displayed cell shares the selected initial noise seed.
fox_selection_decision: Excluded: reviewed fox-astronaut candidates did not reliably match the requested species/space-suit appearance.
